value.rationale: The published reset-scar work characterizes global mixedness and long-range coherence but not whether distant pair correlations are classical-quantum or which reset polarization optimizes a specified two-site geometric observable. The theorem gives finite-rate nonclassicality without entanglement, an exact sharp sparse-reset preparation polarization with a switch in optimal measurement basis, and explicit finite-rate equatorial law independent of chain length/separation. These are natural physical-family invariants and a complete nontrivial design optimization, not arbitrary fixed numerical slices.
